review: W77 source-bound offline explanation of the last applied change
scope: Frozen Runtime3 controller/operation API and W36 lease; isolated receipt-explanation module and candidate send-route hook only. Root owns production script order, HTML integration, and any live/native acceptance.

oracle.supplemental_case: After freezing the oracle, added a stricter current-paint zone-revision mismatch case; this is reported separately from the original 15-case oracle.

implementation.module_api: SpbAiReceiptExplainer.claim(text) strictly recognizes standalone last-change questions. explain(log, isCurrent) derives only from AI history entries with actual applied lines or explicit 'Could not apply' notes.
implementation.controller_hook: Candidate hook in send() runs after the existing instruction preflight and before general self-help/action routing. It queues no operation and uses the frozen controller's operation ticket, document identity, and revision to require a still-current receipt.
implementation.identity_gate: The candidate requires the entry's bound request ticket to match current source generation, committed generation, path, content fingerprint, canvas identity/dimensions, layer/image references and readiness through SpbAiOperation.sameDocument; it also requires ticket.revision === operationRevision(). Same-path source reload, canvas replacement, or intervening zone/layer revision therefore fails closed.
implementation.reply_contract: Success lists recorded applied lines for the currently loaded paint. Partial results list both successful lines and failed operation notes. Failed-only receipts explicitly state no paint change was applied. Undone/superseded receipts are not described as current. Missing, generic-Done, stale, or unbound receipts return a safe unavailable explanation.

verification.coverage: 6 positive and 5 negative phrase-classifier checks; actual candidate send() route; actual finishCore() entry construction using controlled applyQueue effects for success, multi-line, partial, failed-only, and no-line generic-Done records; actual frozen operationDocument/operationRevision/operationManager/operationEntryDocumentCurrent APIs; source-generation reload at unchanged path, canvas reference replacement, manual revision mismatch; undone/superseded flags; mixed action and ordinary-help routing controls.
verification.route_effects: Receipt explanation output has an empty queue and zero provider calls. The mock apply counter remains unchanged during explanation; one controlled mocked apply is used only to generate an actual finishCore receipt fixture.
verification.syntax: node --check passed for both candidate JavaScript files.

limitations: The actual send function and finishCore function are executed from candidate source, but applyQueue is a controlled stub; no real paint pixels, browser DOM, native app, server, or provider were used.
Undone and superseded markers are controlled fixture state. This verifies the explainer's refusal behavior, not the full native Ctrl+Z/redo path that sets those markers.
Ordinary guidance preservation is a route-order control using a stub self-help claimant; no attempt was made to alter the self-help knowledge source.
The new module is not wired into HTML/script load order and the isolated candidate is not installed. Root must load the module before proAI and decide whether to integrate it.
This is an explanation of recorded operations, not visual proof that current pixels match the receipt; no rendered preview is claimed.
